propositions: The lifespan's shutdown drain waits only on queue.join() for webhook-queued reviews but does not await reconciler in-flight reviews, causing them to be cancelled within shutdown_cancel_seconds (~10s) instead of the full shutdown_drain_seconds (~1200s) budget.

Any container stop outside the autodeploy defer path (docker compose restart, manual deploy, host reboot, rollback) kills a reconciler review with no drain and no error emission because cancelled reviews fail silently.
The reconciler must not start new reviews once shutdown begins, or the drain deadline could extend indefinitely; this requires a cooperative stop signal alongside the drain wait.
The shutdown drain wait must share a single shutdown_drain_seconds() deadline across both queue and reconciler paths to respect the existing stop_grace_period (1320s) and not exceed it.

The cursor low-water-mark invariant (added in 9f63) requires that all remaining candidates be recorded in held_back when reconcile loop exits, or they become unreachable if the cursor advances past them.
The drain gate must poll the actual voter.in_flight_reviews() counter so that blocking operations in review_and_vote (e.g. events-log fetch) do not consume the full shutdown budget unconditionally.
